Hi Sofia / Alan,

Thanks again for the call earlier — excited to get MerchantConnect onboarded. Attached are a short SOW draft and a quick questionnaire to help us map the Order Form fields to your implementation needs. To keep contracting lean, can you help with the items below before we kick off redlines?

Top asks (quick):
- Confirm hosting region(s) for production traffic and any EU data residency requirements.
- Identify the primary billing contact and whether you need monthly or quarterly invoicing.
- Flag any non-standard export control or residency constraints (e.g., EU-only, on-prem exceptions).
- Call out specific SLA targets or penalty caps you expect in the Order Form.

We’d like to run a short handoff meeting with your procurement + legal to align on: timeline for final MSA, whether you want a single signatory flow, and any procurement templates you require. Suggested slots: 2026-10-20 10:00-10:30 PT or 2026-10-20 15:00-15:30 PT — let me know what works.

Attachments: MerchantConnect_SOW_v1.pdf; MerchantConnect_Questionnaire.xlsx

Hi Nikhil — thanks for the note and documents.

We reviewed the SOW and attached our internal version (MC_Internal_SOW_annotated.docx) with a few implementation notes. A couple quick items from our side:
- Production will be in us-west and eu-west; for now, primary PHI/data will remain in the US, but we may request EU residency for specific EU customers later this quarter.
- Procurement prefers net-30 billing.
- Our legal team will want to discuss SLA windows; we typically target 99.9% for core endpoints but can be flexible with credits vs. termination triggers.

Alan (CC) is our contracting lead — he can join the kickoff. We can do 2026-10-20 15:00 PT. Please send a calendar invite and an agenda.

Also: do you have a standard SOC2 attestation we can reference? If so, Alan will request the latest report.

Best,
